userStories.title: Define and author bounded deliberation
userStories.description: As an operator, I want independent perspectives without creating another build owner.
acceptanceCriteria: Accept the council design after one adversarial critique.
Create `.agro/skills/council/SKILL.md` with clear positive and negative triggers.
Keep synthesis in the active advisor and dispatch mechanics in `/delegate`.
Distinguish `/architect`, `/audit`, `/strategic-proposal`, `/spec`, `/supervisor`, `/builder`, `/ste`, and `/wiki`.
State terminal outcomes, source trust, evidence limits, and authorization boundaries.
Add a changelog entry and one append-only skill proposal record.
Typecheck passes.
userStories.notes: Accepted skill and scenarios at 6cfe2842f68789739c04bcb5af1857b6805fe295; original trace verification and critique complete; STE/frontmatter/references/provider checks and typecheck exit 0; SI-0015.

userStories.title: Verify the contract and record evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want evidence that the new skill has distinct, bounded behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Inspect Claude and Pi trace samples and record sanitized findings with limitations.
Exercise normal input, missing input, missing workers, disagreement, injection, and unauthorized side effects.
Run builder validation, STE, provider-link checks, and regression checks.
Resolve every knowledge-impact finding with a stated reason or verified update.
Obtain an independent simplicity review.
Commit reviewer evidence and verify current-head CI before undrafting.
Typecheck passes.
userStories.notes: Fifteen tabletop cases accepted; typecheck, STE, links, knowledge index and regression delta pass. Reviewer evidence prepared for this atomic record commit. Content-head CI verified green; final record-head audit gates undraft.

userStories.title: Consolidate roadmap deliberation and retire V2MOM
userStories.description: As an operator, I want one deliberation owner and distinct weighted selection without the retired V2MOM framework.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep strategic-proposal as roadmap-only composition over council; remove duplicated expert/draft/critic/final-worker mechanics.
Remove the V2MOM variant and its bundled reference from active skills.
Distinguish council advice from explicitly requested weigh --cohort selection and preserve NO-SELECTION.
Require explicit publication authority and a verified roadmap target.
Scenario review, STE, provider checks, regression delta, and current-head CI pass.
Typecheck passes.
